Standard: Line fittings and component connections are designed such that they are unable to be installed in reverse or inadvertently cross connected with different systems. Hydraulic and pneumatic lines are permanently marked IAW SAE AS5440B, Tubing and Fitting Identification paragraph, to indicate direction of flow, the system designation, and component operated. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review system-level drawings, processes (manufacturer's process specifications), and CAD models to verify that the hydraulic and pneumatic systems are designed to prevent reverse installation of lines or components, and that lines are properly marked.
(2) Review results of a quality assessment or a government in-person sampling of physical inspection(s) (e.g., 30-60-90% of build inspections) of the air vehicle to verify hydraulic and pneumatic lines and components are properly marked.
